justifications.technical_correctness: Logic is sound, but the player is never added to the 'player' group.
justifications.api_correctness: All APIs (get_axis, move_and_slide, body_entered.connect, emit) are valid.
justifications.version_compatibility: Uses Godot 4 idioms throughout: velocity property, no-arg move_and_slide, typed signals.
justifications.architectural_quality: Coin owns its signal and flag; player is decoupled and clean.
justifications.requirement_fulfillment: Movement and one-shot pickup are done; group membership is left to the scene.
justifications.provenance: Claims are not attributed to any documentation or evidence.
justifications.hallucinations: No invented APIs or behaviors detected.
justifications.clarity: Explanation is concise, organized per file, and actionable.
